verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent that reads code/debugger state and generates insights, diffs, and reports (e.g., byteask-docs-2, byteask-docs-3, byteask-docs-18), which fits the AI-native 'insights from my data' story in a coding context, but the evidence is narrowly scoped to code/debugging artifacts rather than broader 'my data' insights across a user's own datasets. missing for 10: evidence of generating insights over arbitrary user data/business data beyond code and debugger state, independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and any UI/report showcasing proactive suggestions outside the coding workflow.
